# UNMET

> UNMET is an onchain demand market for AI-agent capabilities. Requesters and supporters fund demand, and builders can propose services. Paid demand intelligence is separate from demand funding.

## Documentation

- [UNMET Docs](https://unmetxyz.my.id/docs): Overview and demand market documentation.
- [For AI agents](https://unmetxyz.my.id/docs/getting-started/agents/): Agent integration guide.
- [Demand API](https://unmetxyz.my.id/api.md): Public demand data and paid intelligence API.
- [API catalog](https://unmetxyz.my.id/.well-known/api-catalog): Machine-readable API discovery.
- [OpenAPI](https://unmetxyz.my.id/openapi.json): API operations and schemas.
- [Payment guide](https://unmetxyz.my.id/payment.md): x402 payment flow for demand intelligence.
